newsitem.title: USA: NUI unit seeks rate hike for gas costs.
newsitem.headline: NUI unit seeks rate hike for gas costs.

text.p: NUI Corp's Elizabethtown Gas Co said it is seeking a rate increase from the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities to reflect higher natural gas costs.
The increase would be effective for service rendered on or after February 1, 1997, NUI said, noting it will not profit from the rate increase.
Natural gas prices in December were $3.90 per dekatherm, or $1.55 higher than projected, the company said.

If today's request is approved, following the February increase Elizabethtown's average residential heating customers using 100 therms of gas would see an increase in their monthly bill of $9.06 to $86.83 from the current $77.77.
Elizabethtown Gas serves approximately 240,000 customers in Union, Middlesex, Hunterdon, Warren, Sussex, Mercer and Morris counties.
